mainImage.alt: Vellesiya Wiley, a young Black woman in black clothing, stands with attorneys Ben Crump and Van Turner at outdoor microphones during a press conference in Senatobia, Mississippi
mainImage.caption: Vellesiya Wiley, mother of 1-year-old Kohen Wiley, stands with attorneys Ben Crump and Van Turner during a press conference in Senatobia, Mississippi on June 22, 2026, demanding the release of video footage showing how police killed her son.

body.alt: Attorney Ben Crump, presents the findings of an independent autopsy of the baby, Kohen Wiley.
Community members march through downtown Senatobia carrying yellow signs demanding justice for 1-year-old Kohen Wiley on June 26, 2026
body.caption: Community members march through downtown Senatobia, Mississippi on June 26, 2026, carrying signs demanding justice for 1-year-old Kohen Wiley, who was shot and killed by police at a Walmart two weeks earlier.

body.alt: A crowd of mourners dressed in teal and blue gather outside the Hosanna Family Worship Center in Pope, Mississippi for the funeral of one-year-old Kohen Wiley on June 27, 2026
